review.reason: Candidate 4 passes as supplied. Hole 1 is a short 322-yard dogleg-left par 4 with a substantial water hazard to the right and front of the green. It offers a tempting one-shot attack, while the dogleg and water make a safer placement route credible. Hole 2 is a dry 194-yard punchbowl par 3: its approach bunker and greenside sand add consequence, but the target remains playable. Hole 3 is a 573-yard par 5 with substantial water left and forward of the green and a fairway bunker on the opposite side. Staged play has room; advancing aggressively brings the shoreline into consideration. The short attacking par 4, precision par 3, and long three-shot par 5 make a varied round. These hole types and water hazards recur in recent rounds, but the 4/3/5 sequence, dry middle hole, and contrasting water-side choices provide sufficient freshness. Safe tee-option counts of 53/35/54 and the three-shot simulation on Hole 3 support a testing but playable set; the previews show credible landing space. No geometry edits are needed.
